brief: Capital Alpha Partners announces an analyst call held by financial policy analyst Ian Katz on Friday, Sept. 18 at 10 AM ET / 3 PM BST, covering the outlook for financials policy for the remainder of the year. Listed discussion topics: the future of crypto legislation and regulation, noting the Senate's scheduled procedural vote on the Clarity Act on Sept. 15; Kevin Warsh and interest rates, noting the FOMC rates decision on Sept. 16; bank regulation and supervision including Basel endgame, liquidity/LCR, asset thresholds and stress testing; the legal and political battle over prediction markets; how the CFTC will handle the perpetual futures market; whether the midterms will affect financial regulation and policymaking; and what would happen to Trump 2.0 financial regulations if a Democrat wins the presidency in 2028. The note is a registration announcement only. It states no forecasts, levels, or positions on any of these topics and does not argue a thesis; it lists questions the call will address.
